what: Added a camera-free three-subject Hub rehearsal and updated the live skeletal retargeter to solve elbows and knees from the observed bend direction and wrists and ankles from measured endpoints.
why: Known reaches, isolated finger curls, head turns and planted camera feet expose rig errors at the visible mesh while allowing developers to rehearse with the capture hardware idle.
details: A 40 degree head turn and roughly 91 degree index rotation reached the Quest-driven character bones. The three subjects also retained 10 cm of pelvis travel. The fixture sends only to the station Hub input on loopback UDP 17860.
